title: ANYBODY, ANYWHERE
subtitle: Lives in parallel — paired ordinary acts across different decades and rooms
lineage: Primary: SCION 056 (Symmetry) · Supporting: SCION 099 (Out My Window)
theorem: Build a comparison from three pairs of situated recordings. Start with two people preparing a place to sit, let one finish while the other waits, restore a wider contextual view on each side before the next pair, and conclude where resemblance fails at the outcome.
boundary_note: Parallel presentation does not claim simultaneous recording; explicit years (or undated archival states) and separate stereo sound spaces are preserved.

v1_defect_timecodes: Seg #05 (t=21.00s-29.50s): In Pair 2, `c87ef931` (right panel) cuts across 3 montage shots while `99f04233` (left panel) shows men talking in coats instead of manual bench work.
Seg #06 (t=29.50s-38.00s): In Pair 3, both `c313c355` and `708fb7c2` cut internally near t=36.98s (clip ~8.0s).
critic_tribunal.largest_gap: Pairs 2 and 3 suffer internal montage cuts inside the split-screen panels.
critic_tribunal.causal_hypothesis: Unverified internal cuts inside `c87ef931` and past 8.0s in `c313c355` and `708fb7c2`.
critic_tribunal.falsifiable_repair: Replace Pair 2 (Seg #05) with human-verified cut-free manual desk/tabletop work clips `3a48bbc4` (`Fundo in Chile`, `0.2s-8.2s`, two people working with plans/tools) vs `9bb420b0` (`Make Art Feel Better`, `1.0s-9.0s`, hands carving wood at table); clamp Pair 3 (Seg #06, `c313c355` vs `708fb7c2`) to `in_a=0.2, in_b=0.2, dur=7.2` so both panels finish cleanly before the 8.0s cut.
critic_tribunal.strength_to_preserve: Pair 1 (`c0c5c8e6` vs `98a82cba`) and its two wide contextual restorations (`bb5ffe06` and `4ccd304a`).
